Which of the following Mughal monuments is INCORRECTLY paired with its primary architectural feature?
options_english: Humayun’s Tomb — Double dome and Persian Charbagh layout
Buland Darwaza — Red and buff sandstone with marble inlay
Taj Mahal — Pietra dura inlay work and white marble construction
Red Fort Delhi — Ashlar basalt masonry and Dravidian towers
questions.explanation_english: The Red Fort in Delhi is constructed primarily using red sandstone laid in fine masonry, representing the height of Mughal imperial architecture under Emperor Shah Jahan. It features Indo-Islamic design elements, ornamental marble pavilions, and intricate arched gateways rather than ashlar basalt masonry or Dravidian towers. Basalt masonry and Dravidian architectural towers are characteristic of southern Indian temple architecture and Deccani regional styles, not Delhi Mughal forts.

key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Red Fort Delhi — Ashlar basalt masonry and Dravidian towers
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Red Fort in Delhi is constructed primarily using red sandstone laid in fine masonry.

phase in the evolution of Dravidian architecture?
questions.explanation_english:
The historic Meenakshi Sundareswarar Temple
at Madurai represents the architectural zenith

ceiling vaults, and sculptured granite monoliths

questions.question_english: 13. Which tribal festival, celebrated at Medaram in Mulugu district of Telangana, commemorates the historic struggle of a mother and daughter against unjust taxes imposed by the Kakatiya rulers?
questions.explanation_english: Sammakka Saralamma Jatara at Medaram in Mulugu district of Telangana is a massive biennial tribal pilgrimage commemorating a heroic mother-daughter duo. questions.question_english: 96. In which year was the world-famous 'Durga Puja of Kolkata' inscribed on UNESCO’s Representative List of Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity?

questions.question_english: 54. The ‘Lost-Wax Process’ (Cire Perdue) is an ancient metallurgic technique historically utilized in India for creating which renowned cultural artifacts?
questions.explanation_english: The ‘Lost-Wax Process’ (Cire Perdue) is an ancient metallurgy technique historically utilized in India to cast intricate metal sculptures. In this process, a detailed wax model is sculpted, encased in clay, baked to drain molten wax, and filled with molten metal alloy. This technique was masterfully employed to create famous Chola bronze icons like Nataraja as well as traditional Dokra tribal brass items.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। 'लॉस्ट-वॉक्स प्रक्रिया' (Cire Perdue) एक प्राचीन धातुकर्म तकनीक है जिसका ऐतिहासिक उपयोग भारत में जटिल धातु मूर्तियों के निर्माण के लिए किया गया था। इस प्रक्रिया में, एक विस्तृत मोम मॉडल बनाया जाता है, जिसे मिट्टी में लपेटा जाता है, पिघले हुए मोम को निकालने के लिए बेक किया जाता है, और फिर पिघले हुए धातु मिश्र धातु से भरा जाता है। इस तकनीक का कुशलता से उपयोग प्रसिद्ध चोल कांस्य प्रतीकों जैसे नटराज और पारंपरिक डोकरा जनजातीय पीतल की वस्तुओं के निर्माण के लिए किया गया था।

questions.explanation_english: Nuakhai is an agricultural harvest festival celebrated in Odisha to welcome the new rice harvest. Nabanna is the traditional post-harvest festival celebrated across West Bengal with newly harvested paddy offerings. Onam is the grand annual harvest festival of Kerala celebrating King Mahabali’s homecoming. Pongal is a four-day harvest festival celebrated in Tamil Nadu dedicated to the Sun God for rich crop yields.

In which year was the iconic Charminar constructed in Hyderabad by Sultan Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah to commemorate the eradication of the plague?
questions.explanation_english: The Charminar in Hyderabad was constructed in the year 1591 by Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah, the fifth ruler of the Qutb Shahi dynasty. Built to commemorate the eradication of a devastating plague epidemic from the city, this magnificent square structure features four grand arches facing the cardinal directions, surmounted by ornate minarets. It stands at the historic crossroads of the capital city and serves as a primary Indo-Islamic landmark.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। चारमीनार हैदराबाद में 1591 में मुहम्मद क़ुली कुतुब शाह द्वारा निर्मित किया गया था। यह शहर से एक विनाशकारी प्लेग महामारी के उन्मूलन के उपलक्ष्य में बनाया गया था। यह भव्य चौकोर संरचना चार भव्य मेहराबों के साथ है, जो चारों दिशाओं की ओर मुख करती है, और इसे अलंकृत मीनारों से सजाया गया है। यह राजधानी शहर के ऐतिहासिक चौराहे पर स्थित है और एक प्रमुख इंडो-इस्लामिक स्थल के रूप में कार्य करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) 1591
